sfx_review.note: Sits ~100 ms before the cut with no clear transient at the line; a brighter mid-frequency burst appears ~140 ms later, right after the cut, which may be the real accent.

pattern.description: Hard cut from the wide two-orb orbit layout to a much tighter framing of the same two orbs and centre ring, positions matched left/right, followed by a short drift outward as the orbs keep growing and their gradients shift.
pattern.why_premium: The cut lands on the word 'embody', jumping scale while keeping the composition aligned so the eye stays locked, and the continued post-cut drift hides the cut inside a feeling of forward motion.

build_hint.gsap: At the cut: tl.set('.layout-wide', {autoAlpha:0}).set('.layout-tight', {autoAlpha:1}).fromTo('.orb-left', {xPercent:0, scale:1}, {xPercent:-6, scale:1.05, duration:0.4, ease:'power2.out'}).fromTo('.orb-right', {xPercent:0, scale:1}, {xPercent:6, scale:1.05, duration:0.4, ease:'power2.out'}, '<').fromTo('.ring', {scale:0.96}, {scale:1, duration:0.4, ease:'power2.out'}, '<'); animate gradient background-position on the orbs for the colour drift.
build_hint.remotion: Use <Sequence> boundary for the hard cut; in the tight layout, interpolate(frame,[0,12],[0,1],{easing:Easing.out(Easing.quad)}) drives orb translateX (+/-6%), scale 1 to 1.05 and ring scale 0.96 to 1; gradient shift via interpolated background-position.

notes: Code assigns this to shot s002 starting at the energy spike, so the cut itself may be a shot boundary rather than an in-shot event; the measurable motion after it is subtle (low energy). Orb gradient change could be a slowly rotating gradient rather than a deliberate colour shift.
